image_prompt: A whimsical, slightly surreal scene. A comfortable, plush armchair is floating gently in a calm, clear blue sky, as if it's the most natural place for it. A tiny, relaxed person is sitting perfectly upright in the armchair, looking utterly content, perhaps reading a tiny book. The sentence "A cadeira é para sentar." is subtly integrated into the clouds around the chair, as if formed by them, in an elegant, flowing script. High detail, dreamlike quality, soft lighting.
caption: Parece óbvio, mas às vezes a gente complica tanto a vida! 😂 Encontre seu lugar de paz e simplesmente... sente-se. Qual a sua "obviedade" favorita para relaxar? #ObvioMasVerdade #Relaxar #VidaSimples #Conforto #MomentoZen #Aproveite
